# Pkgdx

Read `AGENTS.md` in the project root for global project context.

For any create-feature, create-unit-test, create-documentation or code-review task, follow the
workspace routing in the project root `CONTEXT.md`. In Claude Code, `/create-feature` is the
preferred entry point - unit-test, documentation and refactor tasks route to the same
consolidated `ICM/create-feature` workspace.
